title: 短暂动词不接时间段

examples.en: I have bought this bike for three years.
I have had this bike for three years.

guess.question: 第二句才是对的，问题出在 buy 这个词上——它有什么问题？

options.text: buy 是一瞬间完成的动作，没法“持续三年”
options.feedback: 对！买车这个动作一秒钟就完成了，能持续三年的是“拥有”，所以要换成 had。

options.text: 因为 buy 拼写错了
options.feedback: 不对——buy 拼写没错，问题在它不能表示持续。

options.text: 因为 for 应该改成 since
options.feedback: 不对——换 since 也救不了：since 后面也要接能持续的说法。

rule.rule: buy / die / leave / join / begin / borrow 这类“一瞬间完成”的动词，不能和 for / since 引导的时间段连用，要换成对应的持续表达
signals: for three years / since 2020 + 短暂动词 → 必须换词
rule.formula: buy → have had　die → have been dead　leave → have been away　join → have been in / have been a member of　begin / start → have been on　borrow → have kept　come / arrive → have been here

anchors.en: I have had this bike for three years.
His grandfather has been dead for ten years.
anchors.note: die 换成 been dead（状态）

trap.wrong: He has joined the army for two years.
trap.right: He has been in the army for two years.
trap.why: join 是一瞬间的动作，能持续的是“在部队里”，改用 has been in。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住换词表：买→拥有、死→已故、离开→不在、加入→在……里、借→保留。

check.stem: I ____ this book from the library for two weeks.

options.distractor: borrow 是短暂动词，不能接 for two weeks
for two weeks 要用完成时
die 是短暂动词，不能接 for a year
for a year 要用完成时

check.explanation: die 换成状态表达 has been dead。

options.text: He has left home for two years.
options.distractor: leave 是短暂动词，要换成 been away from

options.text: He has been away from home for two years.
He has left home since two years.
options.distractor: 换 since 也没用，动词仍要换

options.text: He left home for two years.
options.distractor: 一般过去时不与 for 时间段连用表示状态

check.explanation: leave 换成 been away from，表示“离开的状态”持续了两年。
